method: Actual App.tsx pre-render functions + actual HisApi/decoders + minimal state-hook and HTTP doubles; no React renderer/browser.
fixture_transform: Proposal expires set to current time +900 seconds in memory to isolate revision/recovery behavior; original files unchanged.

cases.name: Definitive commit rejection remains pending after refresh
cases.stimulus: POST /commits returns HTTP409 STALE_CONTEXT; subsequent GET /context succeeds.
cases.expected: Definitive rejection should lead to a recovery state that allows a fresh proposal/review, without describing the write as unknown.

observed.error: หลักฐานเปลี่ยนแล้ว กรุณาโหลดข้อมูลล่าสุดและสร้างข้อเสนอใหม่ · STALE_CONTEXT
observed.notice: ยังไม่ยืนยันผลการบันทึก เก็บ key และ payload เดิมไว้แล้ว อ่านผลล่าสุดหรือ retry เดิมได้

cases.name: Committed read-back does not resolve pending state
cases.stimulus: Commit response is lost; GET /context then supplies the matching committed proposal/result from frozen fixture data.
cases.expected: A verified matching result should reconcile the pending operation and be reflected as confirmed.

cases.name: Successful edit plus failed refresh splits displayed and actionable revisions
cases.stimulus: POST /reviews edit returns a new pending version; the immediately following GET /context fails.
cases.expected: Displayed version/hash and the review action binding must stay consistent; otherwise approval must be unavailable.

observed.review_draft: New reviewed summary — synthetic state reproduction
